tagline: International Association Representing the Interests of European Inland Navigation
hero_kpi_rationale: The 2024 IVR annual congress in Frankfurt brought together 225 participants from 11 countries, demonstrating the continued commitment of the European inland navigation sector and the organization's ability to unite key industry stakeholders despite a complex geopolitical context.

kpis.name: Annual Congress Participants
kpis.explanation: Number of participants attending the IVR annual congress from different countries.
kpis.description: IVR 2024 annual congress in Frankfurt (May 15-17) attracted 225 participants from 11 different countries, representing the inland navigation sector's leadership and stakeholder engagement.
kpis.signal: Strong sector participation despite geopolitical tensions

kpis.name: Loss Prevention Colloquium Attendees
kpis.explanation: Number of participants at the inaugural Loss Prevention Colloquium event.
kpis.description: First Loss Prevention Colloquium held in Antwerp (November 4, 2024) attracted approximately 80 participants from Belgium, Netherlands, and Germany, focusing on technical and financial aspects of loss prevention in European inland navigation.
kpis.signal: Successful launch of new recurring industry event

kpis.name: Technical Standards Published
kpis.explanation: Number of technical guidance documents and standards published by IVR committees during the year.
kpis.description: IVR committees published several new technical guidance documents and standards during 2024 to provide the sector with current and relevant information. Specific count not disclosed in report.
kpis.signal: Ongoing technical committee work and industry guidance

kpis.name: Pan-European Sector Coverage
kpis.explanation: Representation across European inland navigation industry including shipping operators, insurers, and survey institutions.
kpis.description: IVR represents interests across inland shipping, insurance, ship's survey, and related sectors through multi-level governance: General Assembly, Board of Management, Executive Committee, Committees, and Secretariat. Maintains observer status in CESNI and collaborates with ZKR and European Commission.
